title: 第147章 惹不起惹不起
slug: 综艺大导演从齐聚初代跑男开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

斗转星移！

成为了全网最火的四个字。

微博热搜第一是它，抖音热搜第一是它，哔站热搜第一是它，快首热搜第一还是它！

全网平台同时沦陷！

直播结束之后，八百万粉丝自发宣传。

配上跑男所有节目倒流的切片，做成了短视频发在抖音上。

很多人感觉在视频里，似乎真的时光倒流了。

斗转星移这四个字的魔力在于，它不仅仅是一个综艺里的超能力名称。

它更像是王祖兰替所有跑男粉丝向时光发出的一声恳求。

恳求时光倒流，倒流到他们还小的时候，还年轻的时候。

倒流到每个周五晚上，全家人围坐在电视机前的日子。

屏幕里倒流的是跑男每一期的画面。

从最后一期收官战，一路倒回第一季第一期的雷峰塔。

无数人都产生了一种时空错乱的感觉。

仿佛自己真的又变成了那个在客厅里，一边写作业一边偷看电视的小孩。

仿佛爸妈还在旁边催促，而你却在磨着：“看完这集就去睡觉！”

现实中谁不想拥有超能力呢？

谁不想拥有一个可以回溯时光的超能力呢？

只可惜谁都没有办法逆转时间。

所以这也是为什么当初代跑男重新聚集之后，会引起这么大热度的原因。

这一次他们又可以在每周五晚守在电视机前，第一时间看到节目的播出了。

而且是跑男团前所未有的大团圆！

从第一季到第六季出现过的全部初代成员都在。

这样的梦幻阵容，这样的再次重逢，对于跑男粉丝来说不是简单的好看两个字能概括的。

是粉丝的狂欢，是圆梦！

吴凡把这次新闻发布会最真实的数据公布在全网。

八百万人在线，三千万累计观看！

这一切的一切，都证明这跑男这一周内，全网超五十亿的话题

这些数据像一座大山。

把那些曾经在各大平台阴阳怪气，冷嘲热讽，骂着跑男数据造假的声音全部压在了山脚下。

让粉丝们压抑了太久的这口气，今天终于痛快地吐出来了。

跑男的粉丝是非常有素质的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Time flies!

It has become the most popular four words on the Internet.

It is the first hot search on Weibo, it is the first hot search on Douyin, it is the first hot search on Bizhan, and it is the first hot search on Kuaishou!

The entire network platform fell at the same time!

After the live broadcast, eight million fans spontaneously promoted it.

Together with the rewind slices of all Running Man programs, it was made into a short video and posted on Douyin.

Many people feel as if they have really stepped back in time in the video.

The magic of these four words "Dou Zhuan Xing Yi" is that it is not just a name for a super power in a variety show.

It is more like Wang Zulan's plea to time on behalf of all Running Man fans.

Begging to turn back time, to when they were still young, when they were still young.

Go back to the days when the whole family gathered in front of the TV every Friday night.

What is shown on the screen is the scenes from each issue of Running Man.

From the finale of the last episode, go all the way back to Leifeng Pagoda in the first episode of the first season.

Countless people have a feeling of confusion in time and space.

It was as if I had really become that kid in the living room again, doing homework while secretly watching TV.

It’s as if your parents are still urging you, but you are saying: “Go to bed after watching this episode!”

Who doesn’t want to have superpowers in real life?

Who wouldn’t want to have the superpower of going back in time?

It's a pity that no one can reverse time.

So this is why when the first generation of running men reunited, it caused so much enthusiasm.

This time they can stay in front of the TV every Friday night and watch the program broadcast as soon as possible.

And it’s an unprecedented reunion for a running men’s team!

All the original members who appeared in seasons one to six are present.

Such a dream lineup, such a reunion, for Running Man fans cannot be summed up simply by looking good.

It’s a fan’s carnival and a dream come true!

Wu Fan published the most authentic data from this press conference on the entire Internet.

Eight million people are online, and 30 million people have watched it in total!

All of this proves that this running man has attracted more than 5 billion topics on the Internet this week.

These data are like a mountain.

All those voices that used to be sarcastic, sarcastic, and scolding Running Man for falsifying data on various major platforms were suppressed at the foot of the mountain.

This breath that fans have been suppressing for too long finally came out happily today.

Fans of Running Man are very qualified.
